about:
DC Equipment, Inc. was founded in 1995 and operates from its headquarters in Bethel Heights, Arkansas, with a 50,000-square-foot manufacturing facility in Geraldine, Alabama. The company focuses on poultry and food-processing conveyance systems, though the names of its founders and its ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The Alabama shop handles every stage of conveyor manufacturing, from raw steel to finished product. Certified welders perform TIG and MIG welding on stainless steel, carbon steel, and aluminum for frames and structural assemblies. A full-service machine shop runs CNC mills, manual lathes, and precision grinding equipment to produce custom shafts, sprockets, bushings, and one-off components. Additional capabilities include metal finishing (grinding, sanding, deburring, polishing), laser engraving for traceability, and final assembly with freight coordination. The company states it can handle projects ranging from single brackets to complete conveyor systems.

DC Equipment serves the poultry and food-processing industries, supplying processors with custom-engineered conveyance systems and a rapidly expanding parts division. Its customers rely on the company for both new equipment builds and maintenance of existing lines, with the service team specializing in redesign-free servicing that extends the life of current assets.

The company's stated mission is to set a global standard for poultry and food-processing conveyance by combining elite engineering, precision fabrication, and a lightning-fast parts network. It backs every custom build and major service project with a one-year guarantee and emphasizes that uptime is the ultimate priority, offering same-day shipping on stocked parts ordered before noon and overnight delivery options.
